title: Exact Leaf Powers on Cycles, Ladders, Crowns, and Multipartite Block Graphs
summary: Exact \(k\)-leaf powers are graphs whose edges are exactly the pairs of leaves at distance \(k\) in a tree. We prove explicit structure theorems for exact leaf powers on several representative graph families that test different exact-distance phenomena. Our most detailed root-classification theorem concerns chordless cycles: all exact \(5\)-leaf roots of \(C_\ell\), \(\ell\ge 8\), are described by a complete terminal block language.
